resources.string: A ring-shaped battery, Wi-Fi and signal icon for your status bar.
Turns the ring on or off. When it is off, your phone\'s normal status bar is used and nothing is changed.
Puts the number inside the ring instead of a plain circle.
Changing the size needs a restart to take effect.
When on, size and position move the icon straight away. Turn it off if the status bar ever restarts while you drag — then changes apply after you tap Restart System UI.
Drag the battery icon left or right
The master switch for all motion. Turn it off for a still battery icon.
A short bounce when the screen turns on.
A quick shrink when the screen turns off.
The lightning bolt flying into the ring when you plug in.
Draws the icon with the graphics chip. Turn it off if the icon looks wrong or your phone feels slow.
Draws the status-bar clock in your phone\'s own font, so it matches the numbers inside the ring. The clock is never moved or hidden.
Taps on the battery icon are handled by the Auto Expand app, so both apps always agree on what a tap means.
Install Auto Expand to make the battery icon respond to taps.
Waiting for the module… If this stays empty, enable Duo Status Bar in LSPosed (scope: System UI) and restart your phone.
The module has not loaded into System UI yet. In LSPosed, enable Duo Status Bar and tick System UI in its scope, then reboot (or restart System UI).
Module loaded into System UI at %1$s
Module is loaded into System UI (see status above)
